title: tc-ai-disclosure
description:
Marks AI-made content – an inline badge that opens what made it, its limits and whether a person reviewed it – or
a quiet notice at the top of an assistant panel that it can be wrong and how to reach a person.

variant.description: "mark" – an inline badge with a card, or "notice" – a paragraph for the top of an assistant panel

kind.description: How much the AI did: generated it, assisted a person, or drafted what a person then edited

label.description: The badge's words; by default "AI-generated", "AI-assisted" or "Edited by you"

model.description: What made it, by the name people know it by – "Review assistant"

madeAt.description: When it was made, epoch ms

limits.description: What it's good and weak at, a short sentence each

reviewedBy.description: Who reviewed it, if a person did

reportable.description: Offers Report a problem (a button that fires tc-report); on by default when `reportHref` is set

reportHref.description: Where Report a problem goes; makes it a link

reported.description: A problem has been reported: the button says so and is off

body.description: The notice's paragraph – what the assistant is, that it can be wrong, where to check

contactHref.description: Where to reach a person – a link under the notice

learnHref.description: Where to read how the assistant works – a link under the notice

dismissible.description: Shows a close button on the notice

dismissed.description: The notice was dismissed and is hidden

locale.description: The language for dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

labels.description: The words it uses, merged over defaultAiDisclosureLabels
